existing_per_mm_contract.caller_quiescence: The caller explicitly supplies --quiescent-mm and excludes ALL native/KD entries and observers across binding/unbinding
existing_per_mm_contract.dedicated_owner: Dedicated original group-leader/current-mm process, one thread before START and after all worker drain
existing_per_mm_contract.drain: Join and actual owner-thread count corroborate the contract; END additionally requires exact owner/current mm, idle pool and clear gate
existing_per_mm_contract.lifetime: Source/module leases and immutable-text provider contract remain required until all native/JIT users drain; sampled instrumentation state is not a substitute
existing_per_mm_contract.limits: A thread count, unlocked count, mmgrab, idle snapshot or exclusive device fd does not establish those exclusions; mmgrab retains allocation, not mm_users
existing_per_mm_contract.selected_interval: All selected-object callers and queries must use ordinary IRQ-enabled task context; implicit perf/IRQ/NMI and unrelated remote-mm users are excluded throughout
